name: Custom Shape 3-Layer Wooden Countdown Photo Frame
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality wood for a sturdy, durable, and long-lasting display piece.
    - Constructed with a 3-layer wooden frame for added thickness, depth, and dimensional detail.
    - Includes a wooden easel stand for stable tabletop display.
    - Comes with metal loose leaf rings for securely attaching and changing the number cards.
    - Smooth wood surface supports clear printing and a neat finished look.
    - Designed as a decorative and meaningful keepsake for pregnancy countdown and memory display.
    📌 Note: Photo is not included.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Frame size: 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    - Easel stand size: approx. 4.48 x 2.17 in ~ 11.39 x 5.51 cm
    - Stand slot width: approx. 1.97 in ~ 5 cm
    - Metal loose leaf ring diameter: Ø 3.2 cm
    - Frame layers thickness: 5mm wood
    - Number cards thickness: 3mm wood
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Layer 1: 2-sided printing
    - Layer 2: No printing
    - Layer 3: 1-sided printing
    - Number cards: 2-sided printing
    - Display stand: 2-sided printing
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Tracks pregnancy weeks, birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, holidays, and other countdowns.
    - Displays ultrasound photos, family pictures, couple photos, pet photos, or milestone memories.
    - Interchangeable number cards are easy to update.
    - Metal rings keep the number cards securely attached.
    - Wooden easel stand provides stable tabletop display.
    - Suitable for nurseries, bedrooms, offices, shelves, party tables, and photo setups.
    - Reusable for different celebrations and milestones.
    - Works as both a countdown tracker and personalized photo frame.
    - Easy to assemble and use:
           +) Open the ring
           +) Attach the number card to the board
           +) Close the ring
           +) Insert the photo into the frame
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for pregnancy announcements, baby showers, gender reveals, and newborn milestones.
    - Great for birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, graduations, and retirement celebrations.
    - Ideal for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Christmas, and other holidays.
    - Suitable for housewarmings, vacation countdowns, family milestones, and pet keepsakes.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 - 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 3-Layer Wooden Countdown Photo Frame

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1 - 0.3  cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
